description: A cream-gold full-length court gown with dark brown/gold geometric embroidered borders has a low square neckline, fitted opaque bodice and attached elbow-length sleeves. A broad decorated dark waist belt has a round gold-toned clasp. A brown woven wrap with gold edges and fringe drapes loosely along both forearms. Small dangling earrings, a pendant necklace, bracelets and a ring provide restrained jewelry. Both hands are visible clasped in front, and decorated closed shoes appear below the hem. The backdrop is plain stone columns and an unadorned dark wooden door.
